text:
sarah: Heads up — main is red. Bazel CI failing on macOS matrix with compile/link errors after the GCC toolchain bump this morning.

sarah: Failing target: //cc/tests:integration_runner, error shows missing symbol from third_party/icu and a link error referencing _ZSt4cout (std::cout).

maria: saw this too locally when I pulled the new toolchain image. Quick log snippet: 
```
ld: undefined symbol: _ZSt4cout
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
ERROR: /workspace/third_party/icu/BUILD:45:1: Linking of rule '//third_party/icu:icu' failed (Exit 1)
```

raj: likely ABI mismatch between std libs in the new gcc image and the prebuilt libs in third_party. Did the toolchain bump change libstdc++ ABI?

sarah: @raj can you try a quick `bazel clean --expunge` + rebuild? I want to rule out stale caches.

raj: rerunning buildkite job now (job 5521). I'll also try building just //third_party/icu:icu locally.

ci-bot: Buildkite: job 5521 started by raj — label: bazel-matrix-macos.

tom: if this is an ABI flip we might need to rebuild the prebuilt artifacts or pin the toolchain. Can we bisect to the exact image tag? Who rolled the image?

maria: ops rolled `gcc-image:v2026-03-17` around 07:12 UTC. Before that builds were green.

raj: local quick test shows the same undefined symbol when linking against the prebuilt ICU. Rebuilding ICU with the new toolchain fixes link locally. So it's the prebuilt binary ABI.

sarah: ok temporary plan: revert toolchain image on CI, open infra PR to rebuild prebuilt native libs with the new image, and schedule a migration window. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

tom: agree. Revert CI image first to unblock prod merges. Then follow up with a dedicated rebuild pipeline for all native third_party artifacts.

maria: filing infra ticket now and a PR to pin the matrix entry. I'll include exact failing job links and the local rebuild patch.

sarah: thanks. @ci-bot once job 5521 finishes post-rerun please paste the job link. Also if anyone sees other flaky macOS targets post-revert, ping here.

ci-bot: Buildkite: job 5521 failed (same link error). https://buildkite.example.com/organizations/redwood/pipelines/ci/builds/5521

raj: logged a minimal repro and attached build command: `bazel build //third_party/icu:icu --config=macos-clang` and `ldd` shows linking to /usr/lib/libstdc++.so.6 from the new image.

maria: infra ticket: INFRA-3245 — "Rebuild third_party native libs after gcc-image:v2026-03-17 bump". PR to pin matrix: https://git.example.com/infra/ci/merge_requests/78

sarah: Great. Leaving this thread open for follow-ups. If someone wants to take ownership of the rebuild, reply here. :+1:
